scope: Fresh final-model source art review on one unchanged model02f9/gamec6258/pilotad0f asset set. All34 actual-model render cases and14 DOM layouts were executed with this source; two actual ordinary-browser footer/navigation regressions cover nonfinal settlement. Terminal/review DOM is explicitly layout-only fixture evidence. No packaged APK, browser-earned full victory, video, native-phone or physical-device claim is made here.

testProvenance.modelStateGeneration: Fresh PureModel.create followed solely by ordinary direction/A/B inputs or neutral active-time ticks. Public-state automation supplies ordinary keys for three complete model victories. A deliberate valid nonmatching sequence plus ordinary undo/refold produces review and third-mismatch loss. Idle and late-started fold produce timeout states. No source mutation or geometry/phase/time injection generates these canvas cases.
testProvenance.ordinaryBrowser: Six menu/playing/pause layouts across960x540 and1280x720 use the production runtime with ordinary browser Enter/P. Both sizes additionally execute ordinary Enter→Space→nonfinal settlement, then hold ArrowRight until the selected crease changes and release it; the DOM footer must equal the completed-fold model message before and after navigation. Browser keyboard automation is not physical-device evidence.
testProvenance.layoutOnlyFixtures: Eight review/won/mismatches/timeout layouts use saved genuine model-derived snapshots injected through a local HTTP response-only script overriding PureModel.create. Production files are unchanged. These isolate text and layout; fixture state is not earned through that browser session, and the runtime menu-selection highlight remains independently initialized.
testProvenance.privateHistoryFixtures: For every render case, all private underscore fields are replaced, then guarded by throwing getters in a separate run. Commands, pixels, HUD and result remain identical. These substitutions are solely noninterference tests and do not count as gameplay.
testProvenance.contextFixture: WEBGL_lose_context explicitly simulates context loss and restoration, proving identical repaint with the same one-atlas batch.
testProvenance.testInputCorrection: An initial new-model attempt reached canvas success and the960 completed-fold footer, then a zero-duration Playwright ArrowRight tap was missed by held-direction sampling. That incomplete attempt is preserved separately. The test now holds keydown until an observed selectedId change before keyup. Production code was not changed for this correction. The corrected complete pass freshly produced both attached reports.

preservedEarlierEvidence.scope: Preserved scratch history only; current result uses the freshly executed final-model reports.

visualReview.conclusion: At both viewport sizes the real nonfinal completed fold shows the completed-fold guidance in full, and it remains correct after switching to crease3. Both boards and the enlarged selector remain readable; translucent stack rendering and short terminal title remain intact. No further source change is needed.

independentStaticReview.scope: Read-only static source/contract/icon review, followed by focused re-review of final effectiveRGBA and corrected pre-fold condition wording. No browser or model tests claimed.
independentStaticReview.findings: No blocking issue. Uses only public geometry/color; effective alpha is1-(1-a)^n, weighted pigment divided by alpha correctly forms straight RGBA; post-half-turn order reversal copies the array and does not mutate state. Settled colors remain exact public RGB. START WITH GLASS ON BOTH SIDES accurately describes the pre-fold condition. Original icons are parseable and self-contained.

renderReview.scope: Final current source canvas rendering. All model states arise from actual create/step and ordinary inputs, independent public-state pilot, or ordinary idle deadline. Private-history substitutions/throwing getters are explicitly noninterference fixtures only. No production state/geometry/time/phase was assigned to make gameplay cases. Model simulation victories are not browser-earned footage.
